verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly support online evaluations. Evaluators can run automatically on production traces, including safety checks, format validation, quality heuristics, and reference-free LLM-as-judge, with filters and sampling rates to control cost. The docs also describe real-time evaluation of live user interactions as distinct from offline dataset experiments, and the feedback scores these evaluators produce can drive threshold alerts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that online evaluators work as documented on live traffic.
